summary: Full end-to-end validation of the new Notifications feature (GET /api/notifications + /admin/notifications page). 8/8 backend pytest cases pass and every frontend test id from the spec is reachable and behaves as designed.
critical_code_review_comments: routes_v2.py has grown large (1938 lines); consider splitting long files into feature modules per code-review guidelines (>700 lines).

list_notifications performs 6 sequential DB reads (users, job_roles, competencies, document_types, worker_competencies, worker_documents). For large tenants this can be slow; consider gather() to parallelize the independent lookups.
The document notification exposes `file_url` in the API response but the frontend never renders it — either drop it from the payload or add a UI link/download action.

Frontend search filter matches name/rut/item/role but not email; documented behavior, but users searching by email prefix (e.g. 'criquelme') get 0 results, which can surprise. Consider including email in the search haystack.
